failureText.reduced: Reduced: the spell lands at half strength.
failureText.backlash: Backlash: it bites you for its MP cost, then lands anyway.
failureText.strain: Strain: you can't cast that Magnitude next turn.
failureText.wild_surge: Wild Surge: it lands, plus something nobody planned.
failureText.collapse: Collapse: nothing happens. The MP is gone.

gridEffects.heat: Burning tiles for 2 turns; water becomes sight-blocking steam
gridEffects.cold: Slow (-1 Movement); freezes water into walkable ice
gridEffects.force: Push 1 tile per 10 Magnitude; collisions deal bonus damage
gridEffects.motion: Pulls enemies toward you; gives allies extra movement
gridEffects.binding: Root for 1 turn; tether two units
gridEffects.light: Reveal hidden units and traps, blind, heal with Shield or Aura
gridEffects.transmutation: Turns hazards and water back into floor
gridEffects.vitality: Heals the caster for half the damage dealt
gridEffects.corrosion: Shreds 2 Physical Defense and 4 Magic Resistance
gridEffects.gravity: Pulls units 1 tile toward the impact; Crush: +50% against the Rooted
gridEffects.lightning: Arcs to a second target within 2 tiles; chains through Wet and Conductive units
gridEffects.sound: Dazes; interrupts charges; shatters the Frozen; double damage to walls and constructs
gridEffects.shadow: No damage: darkens the tiles and makes allies there Shadowed
gridEffects.warding: Shields allies (temporary HP) or Exposes enemies; doesn't stack, refreshes to the better value
gridEffects.poison: Stacking Poison; halves healing on the target
gridEffects.psychic: Ignores Physical Defense; no effect on mindless enemies (constructs, slimes)
gridEffects.cognition: No damage: Marks and reveals the next 2 enemy plans
gridEffects.entropy: Big decay damage; +1 to the Instability target
gridEffects.void: No damage: removes shields, buffs, hazards, constructs, glyphs and affixes
gridEffects.time: Movement and turn-order control (delays an enemy's turn); never grants extra Actions or turns
gridEffects.probability: Nudges odds: rerolls a crit or a miss (data only for now)

advanced.comment: PT Part 8: Vectors learned once the parents' affinity shares reach these thresholds (and the Knowledge Tier allows). Tier 4 is for Act 2 and arena waves 40+. 'disabled' keeps a Vector as data only.

fusion.comment: PT Part 8: two-Vector cards and improvises pay a surcharge by Magnitude. Synergistic pairs lower it (to half, rounded up) and resonate (+15% effect, -1 Instability target); antagonistic pairs add +1 MP and +2 to the Instability target. Three Vectors pay the surcharge twice.

forceRule.comment: PT Part 8: Force is free but weak: Force cards cost 1 less MP (minimum 0) and deal x0.7.

instability.comment: PT Part 8: a cast rolls Stability when its final MP cost reaches its Magnitude's threshold (Minor never; improvised always). Target 10 + (cost - threshold) / 2, +1 Entropy, +2 per antagonistic pair, -1 per synergistic pair (minimum 10). Roll d20 + Stability / 2.
